about: PICK renders (2026-10-08): shots 1-4 unchanged from shots.json plus two extras. Fixed comparison shots for the level-transition variations (2026-10-03). Every variation renders these four shots with the harness below, unchanged; only the code or assets under test change. Map space = metres from the map root; cell (x, y) covers X [3x, 3x+3), Z [3y, 3y+3). World = mapRoot + map. yaw/pitch are Unity euler Y/X in degrees (positive pitch looks down). fov is vertical (the game's 76). The player stands where the camera stands (feet = eye with y 0): lamps light, fade and shadow for that point as in the game. Lamps are frozen at clock 0, so a frame is identical on every run.

image.camera: scene 'First-person camera' (URP data, post on), near 0.06, far = map SightDistance 46 m

harness.file: Assets/Editor/Audit/FrontRoomsTransitionAudit.cs in the clone proj_trans (copy it unchanged into your cp -Rc clone; the same file is at Documentation/research/level_transitions/harness/FrontRoomsTransitionAudit.cs.txt, md5 76a624e3217630e637bdb381af7ca5b1)
harness.options: -only shot1,shot3 renders a subset; -plan also writes <id>_plan.json (zones and edge kinds round the eye cell)
harness.outputs: <out>/<id>_<tag>.jpg and <id>_<tag>.txt (pose, eye cell zone, lamp count)
harness.graphics: needs a GPU session (no -nographics); never two Unity processes on one clone
harness.before: images/shot1_before.jpg .. shot4_before.jpg (one full ShotsBatch run, tag before; poses in logs/shots_before.txt, the cells round each eye in logs/shot<k>_plan.json)
harness.determinism: Render all four shots in ONE call (no -only). URP seeds film grain with Time.frameCount, so a subset run shifts the grain: up to 13/255 per pixel, mean 0.5/255, everything else identical. A full run reproduces the before frames byte for byte (checked 2026-10-03 11:52: shot1, shot2, shot4 identical across 3 runs; shot3 identical between full runs).
harness.helper: harness/run_unity.sh.txt waits until no other Unity has the clone open, then runs Unity: run_unity.sh <clone> FrontRoomsTransitionAudit.ShotsBatch <log> quit -shots <shots.json> -out <dir> -tag <variation>

shots.title: Doorway: Level 0 to Office through an arch (the doorway in Red's screenshot, close)
shots.boundary: Arch (doorless doorway, no trim) on the edge between cell (264,202) Level 0 / Standard 2.9 m and cell (264,203) Office / Standard 2.9 m, on the line Z = 609.0; opening centre X = 793.47, top 2.2 m. The jambs and head are the wall's two 0.08 m skins: half wallpaper, half drywall. Floor cut on Z = 609.0 inside the opening. At right a second border: arch (264,202) | (265,202) Office on X = 795.0. Camera in cell (264,202), 2.9 m from the arch plane, 0.5 m right of its centre.

shots.title: Continuous wall planes across a zone change (corridor crossing an open edge)
shots.boundary: Open edge between cell (255,195) Level 0 / Standard and cell (255,196) Office / Standard on the line Z = 588.0, X 765-768. Both corridor walls run straight across it and switch paper on that line (flat seams): west wall X = 765 (an arch to Office in row 195, wall in row 196), east wall X = 768 (wall in both rows; row 196 is a split Office | Level 0 wall). Floor (loop pile to carpet tile) and ceiling (2x4 to 2x2) change on the same line. Camera in cell (255,194), 3.1 m from the cut.

shots.title: Ceiling height step: door from Office (2.9 m) into Level 0 Low (2.4 m)
shots.boundary: Door (1.0 x 2.1 m, Cove_Base trim, leaf pushed open from the Office side so it swings into the Level 0 room) on the edge between cell (253,199) Office / Standard 2.9 m and cell (253,200) Level 0 / Low 2.4 m, line Z = 600.0, door centre X = 760.5. The step is closed only by the wall: 0.8 m of drywall over the door head on this side, 0.3 m of wallpaper on the far side; paper, carpet, ceiling grid and ceiling height all change in the door plane. Camera in cell (253,199), 2.7 m from the door, eye level, so the threshold, the 0.8 m header and the ceiling line all read.
